step: Pulled into another universe, Adrian Toomes is freed from a cell, builds a new suit and asks Morbius to team up.
Fancy Dan returns as Ricochet, and he and Ox join the Shocker as the new Enforcers until Spider-Man beats them.

entry.k: An Oscorp executive pressuring Dr. Connors
st: Oscorp's Dr. Rajit Ratha orders Connors's serum tested on unwitting veterans, and the Lizard hunts him on a bridge.
Norman Osborn dies of a hereditary illness, and Richard Parker's video reveals Oscorp wanted his research for weapons.

entry.k: A crime boss ruling a Russian prison
st: Kraven gets himself locked in a Russian prison and kills crime boss Semyon Chorney in his private office.

entry.k: Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy's best friend
st: In Gwen's world, Peter Parker turns himself into the Lizard, and he dies after his fight with Spider-Woman.

entry.k: A live-action Prowler from another universe
st: A live-action Prowler from another universe is held in a Spider Society cell with other captured anomalies.
On Earth-42, Aaron Davis is alive, and he helps his nephew, the Prowler, hold the Miles from Earth-1610 captive.
Parafino, a wax museum artist, traps Spider-Man and Betty Brant above vats of hot wax.
Snubbed by the Science Hall of Fame, Dr. Matto Magneto seeks revenge and attacks Spider-Man with a magnetic gun.

entry.k: A musician with a sonic instrument
st: The Fiddler uses an instrument that fires destructive sound waves to take revenge on an impresario.
The Plotter sends his henchmen Cowboy and Ox to steal the blueprints for a missile.
Henry Smythe builds a Spider-Slayer robot to capture Spider-Man for J. Jonah Jameson.
The Kingpin runs a racket that forces druggists to sell fake medicine at gunpoint.
The Kingpin uses a nightclub as the front for a brainwashing scheme.

entry.k: A jewel thief in a giant hat
st: Dr. Dumpty pulls a jewel heist at a gala and is arrested after trapping himself in his own inflated hat.

entry.k: A skeletal being from the fifth dimension
st: Spider-Man comes face to face with the skeletal Infinata, a menace from the fifth dimension.
Norman Osborn hires Spencer Smythe to build Spider-Slayer robots, and Spencer seems to die when the scheme fails.
The Kingpin reveals he has kept Spencer Smythe alive in cryogenic storage all along.
Herbert Landon offers mutants a cure, but secretly works to build an army of super-mutants for the Kingpin.

entry.k: A Nazi spymaster from World War II
st: The Red Skull teams with the Kingpin to claim a doomsday device hidden since World War II.
He turns his son into Electro, but ends up trapped in another dimension with Captain America.
The Red Skull uses the doomsday device to turn his son into Electro, who is pulled into its vortex in the final fight.

entry.k: The ruler of a realm on Battleworld
st: On Battleworld, Doctor Doom kidnaps the Thing, then absorbs the Beyonder's power to fight Spider-Man's team.

entry.k: A being formed from ancient symbiotes
st: The Synoptic, a mass of ancient symbiotes, directs Venom and Carnage in their plan to spread symbiotes on Counter-Earth.
Lady Vermin, a rat-like Bestial on Counter-Earth, clashes with Spider-Man and takes a liking to him.
The High Evolutionary hires the Hunter to track down and capture Spider-Man.
Master thief Black Cat tries to steal the alien symbiote, then helps Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.
Butane burns down a building to make way for a high-rise, and Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.

entry.k: A small-time crook with a fiery secret
st: Ben hunts small-time crook Jimmy Addison, who has fire powers, but a rival investigator shoots him and he dies.
